# google_dialogflow_phone_number

Represents a provisioned Dialogflow phone number ordered through the Google
Telephony Platform (`PhoneNumberOrders`) and managed via the `PhoneNumbers` API.
On creation, Terraform orders a phone number according to `phone_number_spec`,
waits for the order to complete, and optionally binds `conversation_profile`
and `allowed_sip_trunks`. On deletion, the phone number is soft-deleted
(`DELETE_REQUESTED`) unless `deletion_policy = "ABANDON"` is set.

~> **Warning:** This resource is in beta, and should be used with the terraform-provider-google-beta provider.
See [Provider Versions](../guides/provider_versions.html.markdown) for more details on beta resources.

To get more information about PhoneNumber, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/dialogflow/es/docs/reference/rest/v2beta1/projects.locations.phoneNumbers)
* How-to Guides
    * [Official Documentation](https://cloud.google.com/dialogflow/es/docs)

## Example Usage - Dialogflow Phone Number Basic


```hcl
resource "google_dialogflow_phone_number" "basic_phone_number" {
  provider    = google-beta
  location    = "us-central1"
  description = "Basic Dialogflow phone number order"

  phone_number_spec {
    country_code         = 1
    preferred_area_codes = ["256"]
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `phone_number_spec` -
  (Required)
  Required. Specification of the phone number to order when creating this resource.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_phone_number_spec).

* `location` -
  (Required)
  The location of the phone number (e.g. `us-central1`, `global`).


* `description` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. A description of the phone number order (limit is 1024 bytes).

* `conversation_profile` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. The `ConversationProfile` resource name calls to this `PhoneNumber` should use.
  Must belong to the same project and location as the phone number.
  Format: `projects/<Project ID>/locations/<Location ID>/conversationProfiles/<ConversationProfile ID>`.

* `allowed_sip_trunks` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. List of SIP trunks that are allowed to make calls to this phone number.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_allowed_sip_trunks).

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


<a name="nested_phone_number_spec"></a>The `phone_number_spec` block supports:

* `country_code` -
  (Required)
  Required. ITU country calling code for the requested number (e.g., `1` for US).

* `preferred_area_codes` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. Area codes to prefer when ordering the phone number. An empty list means any area code.

<a name="nested_allowed_sip_trunks"></a>The `allowed_sip_trunks` block supports:

* `sip_trunks` -
  (Optional)
  List of SIP trunk resource names allowed to make calls to this phone number.
  Format: `projects/<Project ID>/locations/<Location ID>/sipTrunks/<SipTrunk ID>`.

* `carrier_ids` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. List of GTP carrier IDs allowed to make calls to this phone number.

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `{{name}}`

* `name` -
  Identifier. The unique resource name of the phone number, of the form
  `projects/<Project ID>/locations/<Location ID>/phoneNumbers/<PhoneNumber ID>`.

* `order_name` -
  Output only. The resource name of the `PhoneNumberOrder` that provisioned this phone number,
  of the form `projects/<Project ID>/locations/<Location ID>/phoneNumberOrders/<Order ID>`.

* `phone_number` -
  Output only. Phone number in E.164 format (for example, `+16505550100`).

* `lifecycle_state` -
  Output only. The state of the `PhoneNumber` (`ACTIVE`, `DELETE_REQUESTED`).

* `purge_time` -
  Output only. The time at which this resource will be purged if in `DELETE_REQUESTED` state.


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 40 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


PhoneNumber can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `{{name}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import PhoneNumber using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    name = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_dialogflow_phone_number.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import PhoneNumber using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "{{name}}"
  to = google_dialogflow_phone_number.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), PhoneNumber can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_dialogflow_phone_number.default {{name}}
```
